selected_intent: stop repeated remelting before it consumes nearly all remaining finished output while the current market remains unavailable

proposed_actions.reason: Another 0.20 remelt would leave only about 0.05 finished metalwork and recover only enough raw metal for a smaller workshop cycle; preserve finished stock until supply information changes or a better use becomes available.

declared_uncertainty: The recycling threshold and current no-lot state are simulation fixtures; waiting does not imply permanent workshop closure.
